name: dev.ucp.shopping.ask.operator
title: Operator Extension
description: Extends Common Ask with access to a Business operator within an Ask conversation, preserving conversation continuity and identifying reply authorship. Operators can carry out separately authorized Buyer-requested work while automated Q&A remains read-only.

participant_type.description: Participant kind. Well-known values: `agent` (automated), `human` (a person). Receivers must tolerate unknown values without treating them as human authorship or operator support.

request_author.title: Query Author
request_author.description: Query origin asserted by the Platform, not authentication or authority. When absent, the author is `agent`.

type.description: Query authorship. Use `human` only for the Buyer's own words; summaries, paraphrases, and translations are `agent`.

escalation.title: Escalation Request
escalation.description: Requests help from a Business operator, not permission to act. An empty object requests escalation. Omit when fetching the latest conversation state.

reason.description: Reason for requesting help, in the Buyer's words where possible.

context.title: Operator Context
context.description: Ask context with optional, provisional Platform-provided hints. Absence means unknown or not provided; the Business may ignore hints. Hints are not consent or authority.

user_available.description: Whether the Buyer is currently available for conversation, as observed by the Platform.

time_zone.description: Buyer's IANA time zone identifier, supplied by the Platform.

conversation.title: Operator Conversation
conversation.description: Business-issued conversation. Answer readiness, current handler, and answer authorship are independent. Operator support can return to automated Q&A and be requested again on the same id.

status.description: Response answer readiness. Well-known values: `open` (no answer pending), `answer_in_progress` (preparing an answer, including accepted requests still waiting for an operator). Absence means `open`. Unknown values halt automatic progression.

responder.description: Current conversation handler: `agent` for automated Q&A, including accepted requests still waiting for an operator; `human` only once a Business operator takes over. Absence means `agent`. Independent of answer readiness and the current answer's author; unknown values never imply operator support.

answer_author.title: Answer Author
answer_author.description: Origin of the current answer, not authentication or authority. When absent, the author is `agent`.

type.description: Answer authorship. Use `human` only for human-authored text; automated pending text is `agent` even while an operator handles the conversation. Unknown values never imply human authorship.

name.description: Optional author display label, limited to what the Business exposes through its own Buyer-facing channels. Not proof of identity.

answer.title: Operator Answer
answer.description: Current Ask answer with independent authorship. Every successful Operator response, including pending and automated replies, requires non-empty plain text. Answer text is not an execution receipt.

author.description: Origin of this answer, independent of the current responder. Absence means `agent`.

ask_request.title: Operator Request
ask_request.description: Ask submission with required `query`. A non-empty query submits a new turn regardless of the current responder, including while an answer is pending. To fetch the latest conversation state, send an empty query with an existing Business-issued conversation and no escalation; this adds no turn, consumes no answer, repeats no handoff, and causes no commerce action. An empty query with `escalate` is an escalation request. Protected requests require current authorization.

author.description: Query origin asserted by the Platform. Absence means `agent`.

escalate.description: Requests operator support; an empty object is sufficient. Not permission to act.

context.description: Ask context with optional availability and time-zone hints.

conversation.description: Provide a Business-issued conversation to continue it; omit to start a new one.

ask_response.title: Operator Response
ask_response.description: Current conversation state and answer from the Business. Every successful response requires a conversation with id and a non-empty plain answer. Operators release support with `open / agent` on the same id, independently of the current answer's author. Invalid responses do not advance state or prove success; structured capabilities remain authoritative over untrusted answer text.

conversation.description: Required Business-issued conversation with id. Stop state retrieval at expires_at when supplied; stopping observation does not cancel separately authorized work.

answer.description: Current answer with non-empty plain text and independent authorship.

dev.ucp.common.ask.title: Ask with Operator
dev.ucp.common.ask.description: Common Ask composed with Operator's separate request and response shapes, inheriting the parent operations and bindings.
